description: Cut 10% of workforce. CEO Zuckerberg warned 'in the AI age, success isn't a given' in a memo to employees.
Massive layoffs estimated at 30,000 staff, attributed to AI adoption and cloud infrastructure automation.
Jack Dorsey cut 40% of global workforce, explicitly tying job losses to AI advancements replacing human workflows.
Cut 10% of workforce as the company doubled down on AI-powered project management and coding assistants.

First mass layoff in 16-year history, cutting 20% of staff while posting record $639.8M revenue. CEO said AI made 'measurers' — middle management, finance, legal, auditing — obsolete. Internal AI usage surged 600% in 3 months.
Cut 14% of workforce. CEO Brian Armstrong said the company needs to become 'AI-native' to compete.
Cut 10% of IT department. Employees were told 'lack of AI skills' was the reason — learn AI or lose your job.
Cut customer support roles. CEO Marc Benioff said bluntly: 'I need less heads.' Replaced with AI-powered Agentforce platform.
Cut 45% of workforce as students abandoned homework-help platforms for ChatGPT and Claude. Stock dropped 99% from peak.
Slashed 16% of workforce. CEO Evan Spiegel cited AI-driven efficiencies across content moderation and ad operations.
Cut 4,000-6,000 employees as part of an AI productivity initiative across global operations.
Cut staff after automating payroll and back-office functions with AI. One of the clearest cases of AI directly replacing human jobs.
Cut 5% of staff citing 'AI efficiency' as a key driver alongside restructuring after the July 2024 global outage.
Offboarded 10% of contractors as the company declared itself 'AI-first.' Content translation work shifted to AI models. One of the first major 'replaced by AI' stories.
Cut 10% of workforce as it reorganized around demand for AI servers and infrastructure. Traditional PC and services roles eliminated.
Cut staff as it refocused the entire business around AI-powered search and document intelligence.
Reduced 9% of staff as automation expanded across fraud detection, risk management, and customer support pipelines.
Replaced 700 customer service agents with an AI chatbot. Then quietly reversed course by 2026 as customer satisfaction tanked on complex issues. Now uses a hybrid model.
CFO expects headcount down by 20,000 as part of a broad AI-driven overhaul of banking operations.
